caption: The drawing consists of a central, detailed pencil illustration of a lidded tankard with a perforated, domed lid and a decorative finial at the top. The tankard features a curved handle with a thumb rest and sits on a slightly raised base; the cylindrical body is plain with subtle shading to indicate volume. The drawing is rendered in shades of grey on an off-white or light tan background. The central section is bordered by a double-lined rectangular frame. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller inset drawing showing a circular, ornate design possibly representing an engraved emblem or medallion, featuring intricate flourishes and some inscribed text or monogram in the center. In the lower right corner, another inset contains a scaled schematic of the tankard, including dimensions and small technical symbols beneath the outline, all drawn in simple linework. The artist’s signature and a date or code appear at the lower right of the central frame.
title: Silver Dredger
